title: Relief of Genoa
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Relief of Genoa", at revision 1370706668, opens: "The Relief of Genoa took place between 28 March 1625 and 24 April 1625, during the Thirty Years' War. It was a major naval expedition launched by Spain against the French-occupied Republic of Genoa, whose capital, Genoa, was being besieged by a joint Franco-Savoyard army composed of 30,000 men and 3,000 cavalry." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7311095, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1625 Spanish expedition against the French-occupied Republic of Genoa". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
